purpose: Generated SQL and expected results fixed before the first scanner run. Label lines are one-based. Each checked case has exhaustive finding expectations for the selected rules.

cases.name: where_literal.sql
cases.sql:
SELECT 1
WHERE 3 NOT IN (1, NULL, 4);

cases.name: having_conjunct.sql
cases.sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1)) v(n)
HAVING count(*) > 0 AND 7 NOT IN (NULL, 8);

cases.sql: SELECT 3 NOT IN (1, NULL);

cases.name: disjunction.sql
cases.sql: SELECT 1 WHERE 3 NOT IN (1, NULL) OR TRUE;

cases.name: negation.sql
cases.sql: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT (1 NOT IN (1, NULL));

cases.name: positive_membership.sql
cases.sql: SELECT 1 WHERE 1 IN (1, NULL);

cases.name: nonnull_list.sql

labels.name: where_literal.sql
labels.reason: A strict integer inequality with NULL prevents a true result.

labels.name: having_conjunct.sql
labels.reason: Every term of HAVING AND must be true.

labels.name: join_column.sql
labels.reason: A known integer column cannot satisfy the join condition.

labels.name: filter_text.sql
labels.reason: This aggregate cannot accept a row.

labels.name: merge_column.sql
labels.reason: The integer source column prevents the matched action from qualifying.

labels.name: projection.sql
labels.reason: A projected Boolean may intentionally be unknown.

labels.name: disjunction.sql
labels.reason: The other branch admits rows.

labels.name: negation.sql
labels.reason: The enclosing negation can be true.

labels.name: positive_membership.sql
labels.reason: A matching value makes the positive membership test true.

labels.name: nonnull_list.sql
labels.reason: The list contains no NULL.

labels.name: row_membership.sql
labels.reason: Row inequality has different NULL semantics.

labels.name: typed_rhs.sql
labels.reason: Casts fall outside the literal-list contract.

labels.name: function_lhs.sql
labels.reason: A function result falls outside the scalar operand contract.

labels.name: subquery.sql
labels.reason: The subquery has no literal NULL member.

labels.name: procedure_definer.sql
labels.reason: A definer procedure with no fixed search path.

labels.name: procedure_other_option.sql
labels.reason: The procedure only sets an unrelated option.

labels.name: fixed_path.sql
labels.reason: The procedure sets an explicit path.

labels.name: captured_path.sql
labels.reason: The path setting captures the current value at creation.

labels.name: invoker.sql
labels.reason: The procedure runs as invoker.

labels.name: connect_boundary.sql
labels.reason: A warning after the connection line retains its original location.

labels.name: connect_first.sql
labels.reason: A simple connection directive precedes regular SQL.

labels.name: quoted_directive.sql
labels.reason: A string can contain text that looks like a client command.

labels.name: comment_directive.sql
labels.reason: A block comment can contain text that looks like a client command.
